message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the training/test data files or model configuration parameters anywhere in the visible code.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there are no remote fetches, and consequently no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are present.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data-preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to training samples before they are fed into the model.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a saved model from a path (predict_path) with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the provided snippets.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no gradient anomaly detection, activation analysis, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard torch.optim.Adam with no DP wrapper (e.g., Opacus or TensorFlow Privacy) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The traindata_file and testdata_file both point to the same file ('db_generated_instances.txt'), meaning there is no held-out test set isolation, and there is no signing, hashing, or multiple independent metric validation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes raw sentence strings directly to trainer.predict() with no shape, length, type, or content validation performed beforehand.
No detected output bounds checks: The decoder processes class_probabilities and Viterbi scores without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the returned tags.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a sequence-labeling/relation-extraction model, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
